pr_title: fix: Breadcrumbs and titles on AccountLayout pages
pr_body: ## What kind of change does this PR introduce? Fixes https://github.com/supabase/supabase/issues/13659 ## What is the current behavior? Breadcrumbs is showing wrong on pages which are using AccountLayout after navigated back from /project/* pages ## What is the new behavior? Hide org name and selected project name on LayoutHeader when project ref param is not set --- This code was written and reviewed by GitStart Community. Growing great engineers, one PR at a time.

issue_context.title: [studio] Breadcrumbs in invalid state when going back to /projects route
issue_context.body: # Bug report - [x] I confirm this is a bug with Supabase, not with my own application. - [x] I confirm I have searched the [Docs](https://docs.supabase.com), GitHub [Discussions](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/discussions), and [Discord](https://discord.supabase.com). ## Describe the bug Breadcrumbs retain the last seen org and project even when going back to studio home page ## To Reproduce 1. Go to https://app.supabase.com/projects 2. Click on any project 3. Go back 4. Breadcrumb will be `//projects` 5. On refreshing, breadcrumbs become `Supabase/Projects` ## Expected behavior Breadcrumbs should be `Supabase/Projects` on the studio home ## Screenshots ## System information - OS: macOS - Browser: chrome - Version of Node.js: 18
comments: Current org and project are fetched from store here and these are being used to show the breadcrumbs. https://github.com/supabase/supabase/blob/master/studio/components/layouts/ProjectLayout/LayoutHeader/LayoutHeader.tsx#L23 A possible fix - * clear these from `ui` store when loading studio home page (need to do this for all pages which are not on relevant org, project) I think this is just a bug that is mistakenly showing the project name on the home screen when it shouldn't do. Rather than trying to change what is on the homepage breadcrumb, we should just be showing the below. I'm not even sure why we are fetching anything from the store here. It can just be hardcoded. The current breadcrumb state is derived from `projectRef`, `organization`. This is set inside the withAuth.

review_comments: @joshenlim I updated these page titles, IMO it makes more sense than just "Supabase | Supabase" like current version. WDYT?
